text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times she visualizes 
it, she cannot see a path to victory over 
Symboli Rudolf. Narita Brian continues to 
struggle in the dark.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She poured her heart out, revealing 
everything. Yet her Trainer responded with 
unwavering eyes: "You can definitely win."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian regained her spirits at those 
words, remembering that her Trainer had 
always believed in her victory...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the press conference before the Japan 
Cup, Narita Brian declares that she will 
surpass the "Emperor." She and Symboli 
Rudolf then share a firm handshake.
